# Samora Legal

> Samora Legal helps people find out if they qualify for Social Security Disability Insurance (SSDI) and other disability benefits through a free 2-minute eligibility screening. We are a private company and are not affiliated with the Social Security Administration or any government agency.

## About

- Free SSDI eligibility screening — no upfront costs, no obligation.
- Connects qualifying applicants with vetted disability benefits advocates and attorneys.
- Built by disability advocates and activists who have lived it themselves.

## Key Pages

- [Home / Eligibility Check](https://samoracare.com/): Free 2-minute SSDI eligibility screening.
- [Get Started](https://samoracare.com/get-started/): Detailed intake form for disability benefits applicants.
- [Privacy Policy](https://samoracare.com/privacy-policy/): How we handle your data.
- [Terms and Conditions](https://samoracare.com/terms-and-conditions/): Terms of use.
- [Accessibility Statement](https://samoracare.com/accessibility-statement/): Our accessibility commitment.

## Notes

- SSDI is a federal program administered by the Social Security Administration (https://www.ssa.gov/benefits/disability/).
- Eligibility generally requires being between 18 and full retirement age, having a qualifying work history, earnings below the Substantial Gainful Activity threshold, and a medical condition expected to last at least 12 months.
